notes: linkedin._comment: Person gates for the LinkedIn arm. countries/cities anchor on the COMPANY's location (from our own OSM sourcing), never the person's profile location — a 'Dubai' profile at a Dubai company is fine, a 'Dubai' profile at a Paris company is not.

linkedin._accept_tiers_comment: T1 ONLY (user directive 2026-07-31: 'they should be the owners/CEOs of businesses'). T2 is heads-of and directors — senior, but employees, not the person who decides. Accepting T2 was letting a sales director into an owner-only campaign.

linkedin._school_boost_comment: Shared-university hook: David is at AUB, so a Lebanese-university alumnus now working in the Gulf can be opened on honestly ('we both came through AUB'). Nothing here filters WHO is contacted — it only ranks who is contacted first.

linkedin._title_tiers_comment: MERGED ON TOP of the built-in owner/CEO dictionary in qualify_people.py (chairman, CEO, founder, co-founder, owner, proprietor, partner, managing director/partner, president, general manager). These are the owner-equivalent titles the three sourced verticals actually use.

GCC outreach-system campaign, built from the 2026-07-27 GTM research. UAE-first: Dubai + Sharjah real estate brokerage is the beachhead (measured 2026-07-27: 529 named brokerages across the two, only 47 with a website tag, 482 name-only — which is why resolve_domains is ON). Education and insurance follow as Tier-2. KSA cities trail the UAE ones. NOTE: the research's other Tier-1 vertical (Salla/Zid COD merchants) is NOT sourceable here — online stores have no OSM presence at all.
